description: get_platform_config still flattens DatabaseConfig extras into a dict; each PlatformAdapter.from_config hand-picks constructor keys. Tuning keys have a shared forwarding list, but there is no producer/consumer contract distinguishing intentionally ignored metadata from a semantically required new field. Inventory from_config implementations, classify producer keys, and add a focused test so a required producer field cannot be silently omitted. Preserve platform-specific filtering. Do not fold in the DuckDB max_temp_directory_size pass-through (duckdb-from-config-drops-constructor-read-keys).

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0 tests/unit -k 'from_config and required' -q
verifications.description: Focused contract test fails before the guard and passes after

work_units.evidence: Classified producer keys in platform_config.REQUIRED_FROM_CONFIG_KEYS; stripped metadata vs required tuning keys vs adapter extras.
work_units.summary: Inventory from_config implementations and classify producer keys as consumed, ignored metadata, or required-but-dropped

work_units.evidence: Contract test pins REQUIRED_FROM_CONFIG_KEYS as a subset of TUNING_FORWARD_KEYS and asserts build_adapter_config forwards them.
work_units.summary: Add a contract or focused test for semantically required producer fields
